purpose: Teach: キックオフ/型式/買い取っ/アダプター/コネクタ/ブランク/送り出す/圏外

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: プロジェクトのキックオフを来週設定しましょう
lines.en: Let's set the project kickoff for next week.
lines.style: Crisp, forward-moving. Light emphasis on 'next week.' Efficient but not rushed. The tone of someone organizing, not ordering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新型式の機械の試験運転を予定します
lines.en: Got it. I'll schedule the trial run for the new equipment.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Direct eye contact. No hesitation — this is noted and will be done. Warm enough to feel like partnership, not subordination.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 中古品を買い取って下さる取引先を探しましょう
lines.en: We should find a vendor who can take used equipment off our hands.
lines.style: Thoughtful directive. Slight pause before 'vendor' — thinking through logistics. Clear but collaborative. Not commanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。アダプター互換性の一覧を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll put together a list of adapter compatibility specs.
lines.style: Quick acknowledgment. Spoken as if already mentally opening a document. Reliable, unbothered. The confidence of someone who knows what needs doing.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内のコネクタ規格を統一しましょう
lines.en: Let's standardize the connector specifications across the office.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact planning tone. Slight lean forward — this matters for the bigger picture. Professional but not stiff. A suggestion that's also a gentle requirement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修日程にブランクを入れて休憩を確保します
lines.en: Got it. I'll build buffer time into the training schedule so people can actually rest.
lines.style: Committed undertone. Slight warmth here — he's hearing the practical concern beneath the ask. Quick, assured delivery. This will happen.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新サービスを送り出す日程を確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's confirm the launch date for the new service.
lines.style: Clear directive. Measured pace. This is the moment everything hinges on — voice reflects that weight without sounding tense. Professional and present.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。外勤先での圏外対応を整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll make sure we have coverage for areas without signal at remote sites.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Calm, thorough. No surprise in the ask — he's already thinking three steps ahead. Ends on a note of completion and readiness.
